1.1.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the GetResponse API.
1.1.1: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
1.1.2: CreateContact: Custom Field Value set in the Designer is now accepted and sent as the list of values. The field was typed as an array while its inspector stores rows as an object, so every value failed validation (#1408).
